   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

n## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

n## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```

```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

h## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```

```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec

 ## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

e## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.

<## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

t## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws

capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

h## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws

capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```

u## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

o## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

t## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```

```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

l## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

s## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.

e## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.

b## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

e## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which

form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

t## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

   dashboard.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

o## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.

   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

t## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

i## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,

existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.
2. **Google Apps Script** (optional) -- appends a row to a Google Sheet *and*
   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.

### Setup you must do (needs your accounts)

**Email + Google Sheet** -- see `docs/google-apps-script.gs`. Create a Sheet,
paste the script, deploy as a Web app with access **"Anyone"**, then set on
Netlify:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SHEETS_ENDPOINT = https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec
```

It is a build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, so **redeploy after setting it**.
Unset, the form still works -- it just skips the mirror.

**Netlify email notifications** (belt and braces, no code): Site configuration
-> Forms -> Form notifications -> add `ac@bfunded.io`.

`public/__forms.html` declares the form for Netlify's build-time parser, which
cannot see a React-rendered form. **Its field names must stay in sync** with the
form in `app/_content/home.json` -- a field missing there is silently dropped
from Netlify submissions.

u## The waitlist form

Lives on `/` ("Join The Founding Cohort"). Fields, in order:

`name` · `email` · **`role`** · `company` · `website` (+ hidden `source`, `form-name`, `bot-field`)

`role` is a required dropdown -- **Founder** or **Investor** -- sitting directly
above Company Name. It reuses `text-field-47 w-select` so it inherits the
existing field styling; Chrome paints `<select>` with its own widget background,
so a small `#role` rule disables the native appearance, forces white and draws
the chevron, making it pixel-match the text inputs.

This is the one intentional divergence from `public/contoh/home.html`: the
captured page has no such field, so `/` renders **81px taller** than the capture.
Everything else on the page is unchanged.

### Where submissions go

Each submit fires **two** requests:

1. **Netlify Forms** (`/__forms.html`) -- the system of record. Determines the
   success/failure UI. Full searchable history + CSV export in the Netlify
   dashboard.

   emails `ac@bfunded.io`. Sent fire-and-forget with `mode: 'no-cors'`, so a
   Sheets outage can never block or fail a real submission.

The original posted to Webflow's backend behind a Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge, which only works on Webflow-hosted domains -- hence the rewiring. A
capture-phase handler intercepts the submit before Webflow's own handler and
reuses Webflow's `.w-form-done` / `.w-form-fail` UI.
